summary.text: Carey Marin is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 2, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Scott Baldermann (D).
A communications consultant and small business owner, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on lowering the cost of living and controlling government spending.

paragraphs.text: Carey Marin earned a high school diploma from Van Alstyne High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of North Texas, and her career experience includes working as a communications consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Marin said she is a small business owner, has been married for 28 years and is the mother of four teenagers.

She said she would work to bring spending under control, protect the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights, push back against new taxes and fees, support law enforcement and pursue an approach to homelessness that measures results.
